info.description: Disabled-by-default candidate. Shared canonical Proof and human capture services; no service-principal attestations. See docs/partner-foundation/README.md for activation and evidence gates. Legacy /v1/openapi.json remains compatible.

post.description: Required scope: proofs:write. Immutable order snapshot and explicit operator assignment; permanent scoped business uniqueness. Reusing an order with another idempotency key returns created:false; same-key replay returns the original result.

post.description: Required scope: capture:request. Returns the existing packproof.capture/1 schema, intentId, launchToken and expiresAt, plus merchant/environment and requiresAuthenticatedAttestation. Only the assigned authenticated operator can exchange it through existing first-party capture routes. Deliver via a URL fragment; do not log it.
